messages:
Olivia (People Ops): Heads up — a finance person forwarded an email asking them to "verify company billing". Link went to a PDF on cdn-files[.]cloud and the embedded form asked for card digits. They entered last 4. Can someone triage?
Maria (SecOps): Thanks — can you forward the original email headers and the exact URL? Also who clicked (name/email)?
Olivia (People Ops): Forwarded to @Maria. Clicker is Sam Lee (sam@redwood.ai). URL: https://cdn-files.cloud/view/receipt-2026.pdf (screenshot uploaded).
Maria (SecOps): Kicking off sandbox. @PhishSandboxBot, run quick fetch + form extraction on that URL.
PhishSandboxBot: Fetch started for https://cdn-files.cloud/view/receipt-2026.pdf
PhishSandboxBot: Result: PDF contains embedded form that posts to https://payments-external[.]io/submit. Form fields: name, company, card_number, exp, cvc. No malware payload. Verdict: credential/PCI collection (malicious).
Raj (Security): Block cdn-files.cloud and payments-external[.]io at the gateway and add both to our outbound blocklist. Also escalate to PCI lead — we had card data exposure.
Jordan (SRE): Jordan checking edge logs for the CDN fetch. Command I ran: ```curl -I "https://cdn-files.cloud/view/receipt-2026.pdf"``` Response headers show a public 200 and referrer logs show sam@redwood.ai IP hit at 191.12.45.8. No other hits from corp range yet.
Maria (SecOps): Action plan: 1) Revoke any tokens and temporary creds Sam used today. 2) Run account risk check for Sam (MFA, signins). 3) Add IDS rule to block POSTs to payments-external[.]io. 4) Notify payroll/finance.
Raj (Security): I revoked Sam's session tokens and forced a password change. Also flagged the sender domain and filed an abuse report.
Olivia (People Ops): Should I trigger an org-wide note? We need to tell folks not to enter card details into random PDFs.
Maria (SecOps): Short comms recommended: "If you clicked the link and entered card details, contact Security immediately at secops@redwood.ai and Finance to review your card. Do not reuse passwords; we will reach out for follow-up." I'll draft a bulletin.
Raj (Security): Also ask Finance to check their vendor billing entries for anomalies. Suggest issuing a temporary block on outbound card updates until we finish triage.
Jordan (SRE): Found two more minor hits from external contractors IPs — blocking that CDN prefix now. No signs of an automated campaign beyond these hits.
PhishSandboxBot: Collated artifacts: captured form POST example (sanitized): ```POST /submit HTTP/1.1\nHost: payments-external.io\nContent-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\nbody: name=Sam+Lee&company=Redwood+Inference&card_number=XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234&exp=12%2F26&cvc=***```
Maria (SecOps): PCI note: we only have last-4 in logs from Sam — still treat as potential exposure. Opened incident INC-2026-87, assigned to Maria + Raj + Jordan.
Olivia (People Ops): I'll coordinate a targeted note to Finance and a company-wide reminder early tomorrow. Also looping payroll to watch for refunds/chargebacks.
Raj (Security): Post-incident tasks: add an automated content scanner rule to flag PDFs that include HTML forms or external POST endpoints; add domain to blocklist; schedule a 1:1 with Finance on vendor verification process.
Maria (SecOps): All containment tasks done except bulletin. Raj/Jordan confirm domain block and CDN prefix blocked?
Raj (Security): Domain and CDN prefix blocked at gateway (confirmed). Abuse report submitted.
Jordan (SRE): CDN prefix null-routed at edge. Logs archived to incident bundle.
Maria (SecOps): Closing thread for immediate containment. Follow-ups: Maria to file retro with playbook edits, Raj to update blocklist policy, Olivia to send comms tomorrow. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
